items.title: Highly sensitive court data accessed by entity based in India
items.description: Highly sensitive Australian court files have been accessed offshore in breach of the privacy act and Commonwealth contractual obligations, an ABC investigation has revealed, raising concerns of a national security risk.

items.title: Skilled workers are considering leaving the trades — and toilets are to blame
items.description: Tradies are walking out. Not over ability or aptitude but toilets — in a symbol of the sector's persistent barriers.

items.title: Liberals recast 'social cohesion' as US-style politics goes global
items.description: If migration is treated primarily as a cultural fault line, rather than an economic system embedded in national growth, the debate will remain loud. The structural reform will remain unfinished.

items.title: Australian women and children with links to ISIS forced to head back to camp in Syria
items.description: A group of Australian families with links to Islamic State fighters are forced to turn around after leaving a camp in Syria to try to begin their journey home to Australia.

items.title: Ex-footballer shot multiple times in Western Sydney drive-by shooting
items.description: Police have been told Matt Utai, who played for the Tigers and Bulldogs NRL clubs, was shot outside a home on the street by the occupants of an SUV, before they fled the scene.

items.title: Concerns after 200 dogs found on breeder's property
items.description: The breeder's puppies were once featured on Kleenex commercials but it is now under scrutiny from the RSPCA and other pet organisations.

items.title: Live: Angus Taylor distances himself from Ley immigration policy
items.description: Opposition Leader Angus Taylor has denied knowledge of an immigration policy that was looking to ban people coming to Australia from terror-declared areas. Follow live.

items.title: Why the Reserve Bank's interest rate hike may be a one-off
items.description: Fresh warnings of further rate rises have been enough to send shivers up the collective spine of new homeowners, but if there's any comfort to be had, it's this: Don't believe a word of the forecasts.

items.title: Cousin says 'all I can do is utter a prayer' as he pleads with abductors
items.description: The cousin of Sydney man Chris Baghsarian, who was abducted in a case of mistaken identity four days ago, says he is praying for the 85-year-old's safe return.

items.title: How Australia leads the world in moguls skiing
items.description: To the surprise of many, the "beach nation" that is Australia is the best moguls skiing nation on earth. How they got there is no accident.

items.title: Warning Australia is a dumping ground for slave-made goods
items.description: Australia's anti-slavery commissioner calls for tough new laws forcing companies to take slavery in their supply chains seriously, as Ansell and Kmart face scrutiny.

items.title: 'Forced confessions' amid government crackdown spells execution fears
items.description: Families of Baha'i youth arrested by Iran's security forces say they've been subject to "forced confessions" and fear they may face the death penalty.

items.title: Andrew Denton was the key to The Chaser's War on Everything
items.description: The Chaser's War on Everything didn't start the fire, but the embers from the beloved satirical current affairs show are still warm after two decades.

items.title: Pod Save Australia: Why our obsession with US politics isn't going anywhere
items.description: Huge crowds have flocked to live shows for the popular and influential Pod Save America podcast, suggesting Australia's obsession with US politics isn't going away anytime soon.

items.title: Live: BHP lifts profit and dividend as it strikes silver deal
items.description: The Australian share market opens higher as investors await half-yearly company results. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Police likely 'looking for a motive' as Gus search continues, ex-detective says
items.description: Police are again at remote Oak Park Station searching for evidence related to the disappearance of missing four-year-old Gus Lamont, with a retired police officer saying detectives are likely "looking for a motive".

items.title: How these 'old-school' Chinese restaurants have survived for decades
items.description: Since the early 90s, these Chinese restaurateurs have served the community they call "family". This is how they've stayed open amid Melbourne's ever-changing food culture.

items.title: Some South Australian school classrooms are 'literally falling apart'
items.description: Almost two years after a state government report revealed 35 per cent of all buildings within the Department for Education's portfolio were past their design life, many schools are still plagued with issues including mould, asbestos and rotting windows.

items.title: Australia spent $26 billion on 'nature-harming' incentives in a year
items.description: The federal government funds $26 billion of incentives each year that may be harmful to the environment and is yet to report on its international commitments, researchers say.

items.title: Austrian man faces terror charges over Taylor Swift concert plot
items.description: Austrian prosecutors have filed terrorism-related charges against a 21-year-old man who they say planned to carry out an Islamist militant attack at one of Taylor Swift's 2024 concerts in Vienna.

items.title: Australian facing jail in Thailand over blog posts cleared by court
items.description: The Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission has dropped a criminal defamation case against Australian writer Murray Hunter.

items.title: Resource to help 'invisible' victim-survivors of sexual abuse — older women
items.description: Experts say sexual violence against older women is "grossly underestimated" as victim-survivors face additional barriers to disclosing the abuse.

items.title: Robert Duvall, star of The Godfather and Apocalypse Now, dies at 95
items.description: Oscar winner Robert Duvall, known for films such as The Godfather and Apocalypse Now, has died at the age of 95.

items.title: Kidnapped Guthrie's family, friends in FBI's sights, says ex-FBI consultant
items.description: As the FBI continues searching for kidnapped 84-year-old Nancy Guthrie in the United States, a former FBI negotiator says they will be focusing on the grandmother's social circle and family.

items.title: Victorian Greens push to give corruption watchdog more power after CMFEU scandal
items.description: The Victorian Greens are calling for broadened powers of the state's anti-corruption body after the watchdog confirmed it rejected a request by the premier for an investigation into the CFMEU scandal because it was out of scope.
